creator: Alexander Terp
description:
The local bridge works; the remote path is the same code with a different child process. muster-bridge spawns 'herdr terminal session control <pane>' - for a remote daemon that becomes 'ssh <host> herdr terminal session control <pane>', and the frame envelopes are identical either way (docs/observations/herdr-0.8.0.md section 8 diffed Linux against macOS and found zero differences).

Worth doing early and cheaply against the devenv container, because 'local and remote in one window' is a founding desideratum and this is the first chance to show it costs the adapter nothing beyond the transport.

Open: where the transport choice is made. The bridge taking a --ssh flag keeps it dumb, but the core is what knows which daemon a pane belongs to.
title: Bridge a remote pane over SSH
